description:
## Problem
actionlint on .github/workflows/ci.yml (develop, 2026-11-24) reports one shellcheck error, SC1087 ("Use braces when expanding arrays"), and style or info findings SC2129 and SC2086. The SC1087 finding is a false positive: the flagged line is `uv pip install ... "$wheel[duckdb]"` in package-smoke, a pip extras spec where bash expands $wheel followed by the literal [duckdb]. Writing "${wheel}[duckdb]" silences it without changing behaviour. No CI step runs actionlint, so new findings are not caught.

## Decision gate
Rewrite the SC1087 line as "${wheel}[duckdb]". For style findings, fix them or list them as accepted. Whether to add actionlint to CI is an owner decision. Default: do not add it in this item; record the owner's answer here when given.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create), never the primary clone; heavy test runs only through lock-taking entry points; never set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK or force admission; stage explicit paths; add a changelog.d fragment if users can see the change; no explanatory comments (make comment-policy-check). ci.yml is a soundness path: follow its review rules.
